messages:
mike_finance: FYI StratusEdge invoice INV-2026-09 (USD 78,400) is 12 days past due. Email to billing@stratusedge.com bounced. Card on file expired. Thoughts on payment plan vs escalate?

kevin_sales: they replied to the sales thread — cashflow crunch, asked for 60d last week. Sent a 'promise to pay' email but no payment yet. Wants product access to continue.

anika_recon: Reconciled usage, charges look valid (mostly test env). I can offer a split: 30% now, remaining over 2 monthly installments. That matches their ask and reduces risk.

mike_finance: OK. Need approvals: collections policy 2 allows up to 90d w/ signed agreement for accounts under $100k? (need confirmation). If we do 30% down, what's the remittance schedule?

legal_oncall: Collections policy allows payment plans but must have signed payment plan doc + ACH/CC authorization. We shouldn't waive late fees automatically. Recommend 30% down, then 35% + 35% at 30/60 days. Add clause for service suspension after 10 days from missed installment. I'll draft the agreement. cc @mike_finance

collections-bot: Dunning email #3 sent to billing@stratusedge.com at 2026-11-12T14:10:00Z — link to invoice https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-09

kevin_sales: Can we do 45-day instead of 30 between payments? Customer pushes for more runway.

anika_recon: 45-day ok, but increases risk. If we go 30/45/45 need bigger down (40%) or require ACH. Recommend 40% down, remainder in two 45d installments.

mike_finance: Approve 40% down + ACH + signed plan. Collections - pls send draft and hold off on service suspension until agreement signed. We'll flag account in CRM.

collections-bot: Created payment plan ticket CP-9802; assigned to anika_recon.

anika_recon: Draft email + agreement attached. Snippet:

``
Hi Maya — following up on INV-2026-09. We can offer a payment plan: 40% due now, 30% due in 45 days, final 30% due in 90 days. Agreement attached; please sign and add ACH details. Once we receive the initial payment, we'll keep service active.
``

kevin_sales: I'll loop in the customer success manager and Meya from StratusEdge to get this signed today. :thumbsup:

mike_finance: Thanks. I'll update ledger and mark as 'pending plan' until CP-9802 closed.
